name: Kanye West
hook: A Chicago producer whose sped-up soul samples made Jay-Z's 'The Blueprint', who then put Daft Punk and a drum machine at the centre of rap, and whose antisemitic statements from 2022 cost him most of his business partners.

blurb.age13: Kanye West was born in Atlanta in 1977 and grew up in Chicago. He started as a producer. On Jay-Z's 'The Blueprint' (2001) he made beats by taking old soul records, speeding them up so the voices went high, and looping them, a style people called chipmunk soul. In 2002 he was badly hurt in a car crash, and he rapped his first single, 'Through the Wire', with his jaw wired shut. His 2007 song 'Stronger' is built on a sample of Daft Punk and helped bring dance music into hip-hop. On '808s & Heartbreak' (2008) he sang through Auto-Tune over Roland TR-808 drum machine sounds, and many rappers copied it. From 2022 he made antisemitic statements and praised Nazism. Companies including Adidas ended their deals with him. He now calls himself Ye.
blurb.adult: Born in Atlanta on 8 June 1977 and raised in Chicago. As a Roc-A-Fella producer he is credited with revitalising Jay-Z's career through 'The Blueprint' (2001), where his sped-up, pitched-up soul samples, called chipmunk soul, became the album's sound. 'The College Dropout' (2004) opened his own career with 'Through the Wire', recorded after a 2002 car crash with his jaw wired shut and built on a sped-up Chaka Khan sample. 'Stronger' (2007) samples Daft Punk's 'Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger' and is credited with encouraging other rappers to use house and electronic music. '808s & Heartbreak' (2008), sung through Auto-Tune over TR-808 sounds, is considered to have had a significant effect on hip-hop. He has named Stevie Wonder's 'Innervisions' and 'Songs in the Key of Life' as the albums he set out to compete with. From 2022 to 2025 he drew wide condemnation for antisemitic statements and support for Nazism; Adidas ended its partnership with him in October 2022 over them. He changed his stage name to Ye.
